title: Why Colos Use Aravolta for Branch Circuit Monitoring
summary: Discover how colocation providers leverage Aravolta for circuit-level visibility, automated alerting, and tenant billing.
body_markdown: Colocation providers face unique challenges in managing power distribution across multiple tenants, ensuring uptime, and delivering transparent billing. Aravolta's branch circuit monitoring provides the granular visibility and automation that modern colos need to stay competitive.
